cases.name: Sandra Sue "Sandy" Chelf
cases.narrative: He reportedly went to his neighbor’s house and told her he had just shot his wife and to call 911. When police arrived, he was reportedly sitting in front of his home. When asked if anyone else was in the residence, he allegedly said, “Just my dog and my dead wife.” She had gunshot wounds to the head and torso.
